title: Legal Document Intelligence RAG
summary: Citation-grounded answers over public Delaware M&A litigation, built end-to-end on Azure.
outcome: A citation-required research workflow over a controlled public legal corpus.
evaluation: Deterministic tests cover ingestion, retrieval, and answer-grounding behavior.
Responses require source citations from approved public chunks.
operationalTradeoffs: The public App Service release remains pending recovery and smoke testing.
The corpus is intentionally limited to approved public opinions.
disclaimer: Uses public court opinions only. Legal information, not legal advice. The public App Service release is pending recovery and smoke testing.
